description: This file defines the ConnectionCommon class, which encapsulates shared resources and services for networking connections within the Orleans runtime. It contains properties for message factory, service provider, tracing, and message statistics sink, serving as a common configuration or context for connection-related functionality.

classes.name: ConnectionCommon
classes.description: A sealed class that aggregates various service components, tracing, and message handling facilities used for network connection management within Orleans.

methods.name: ConnectionCommon
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ConnectionCommon with dependencies for service provisioning, message creation, tracing, and message statistics.
